description.text: Europe’s leading early-stage tech for good VC. We invest in ambitious and diverse founders aiming to positively impact the lives of millions.

targetApplicants.text: We’re not just jumping on the impact bandwagon, we helped build it. Since 2012 we’ve pioneered tech for good. That means our experience and expertise is unrivalled when it comes to building a tech startup with impact at its core.
